frozen_inputs.candidate_family: DENSE random, rnd_cand(seed) as frozen in route_o9_batched_a

locations.rule: SR cells ranked by frozen cells.json C_upper (exact Fraction), ties broken by cell index; EASY=min, MIDDLE=element at index len//2, DIFFICULT=max

moment_shifts.definition: moment_shift s selects panel s of the frozen p1_rule panel partition: z_lo = L_c + 2*s*h, z_hi = z_lo + 2*h, z_c = z_lo + h, with h = span/(2*n_panels)

channels.contract: OB.contract(PanelDrift(shift), rnd_cand(seed)) for every (shift, seed); records every Taylor coefficient coef[a][b] and both error-channel values
channels.selection: H.select_parameters(g, p1, C_SR) for each location's C_upper
channels.certificate: H.certify at the EASY location, seed 0, if it completes within the qualification budget

exact_serialisation: every arb ball is serialised losslessly as [mid.man_exp(), rad.man_exp()] (exact binary mantissa/exponent pairs); no decimal rounding is used anywhere in the comparison

decision_rule.pass: SCIENTIFIC_HASH computed over the canonical serialisation is byte-identical on AWS and Vultr for every declared combination
decision_rule.fail: any difference in any coefficient, error-channel value, selection output or certificate field
decision_rule.no_post_hoc_tolerance: no containment-based, radius-ratio-based or any other equivalence rule may be introduced after observing results; only exact byte identity is accepted
